We have $\mathbb{Q}(a) = \mathbb{Q}(\psi)$ iff the stabilizer $\operatorname{Stab}_G(a)$ is trivial, i.e., $a$ is fixed by no non-identity element of $G$.

Since multiplication by $k$ permutes $\{1,\ldots,6\}$ mod 7, reindexing gives the condition $a_i = a_{ki \bmod 7}$ for all $i$. The number of such binary sequences equals $2^{(\text{number of orbits of } \sigma_k \text{ on } \{1,\ldots,6\})}$.

**Subgroup lattice.** The subgroups of $\mathbb{Z}/6\mathbb{Z}$ and their fixed sets:

| Subgroup | Generator | Elements | Orbit structure on $\{1,...,6\}$ | $|\operatorname{Fix}|$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $G$ (order 6) | $\sigma_3$ | $\{\sigma_1,\sigma_3,\sigma_2,\sigma_6,\sigma_4,\sigma_5\}$ | one orbit of size 6 | $2^1=2$ |
| $H_3$ (order 3) | $\sigma_2$ | $\{\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\sigma_4\}$ | $\{1,2,4\},\{3,6,5\}$ | $2^2=4$ |

| $\{e\}$ (order 1) | $\sigma_1$ | $\{\sigma_1\}$ | six singleton orbits | $2^6=64$ |

Verification of orbits: $\sigma_2$: $1\to2\to4\to1$ and $3\to6\to5\to3$. $\sigma_6$: $1\leftrightarrow6$, $2\leftrightarrow5$, $3\leftrightarrow4$. $\sigma_3$: $1\to3\to2\to6\to4\to5\to1$ (single orbit). ✓

$$N = \sum_{H \leq G} \mu(H)\,|\operatorname{Fix}(H)| = 1\cdot64 + (-1)\cdot8 + (-1)\cdot4 + 1\cdot2 = 64 - 8 - 4 + 2 = 54.$$

$$|\operatorname{Fix}(H_2)\cup\operatorname{Fix}(H_3)\cup\operatorname{Fix}(G)|=8+4+2-2-2-2+2=10.$$
